meta.title: Nexora — Web & Mobile Studio from Sibiu, Transylvania
meta.description: Nexora is an IT studio from Sibiu, Transylvania. We craft fast, modern websites and cross-platform mobile apps with Next.js, React, Node.js, Nest.js, PHP and React Native.

hero.subtitle: Nexora designs and engineers high-end websites and cross-platform mobile apps — on any engine you like, or on a cutting-edge modern stack built for speed and scale.

services.title: Two crafts, one studio
services.subtitle: From a polished landing page to a full cross-platform product — we take it from idea to launch.

web.title: Websites & Web Platforms
web.desc: Marketing sites, corporate platforms, online stores and custom web apps. Built to load instantly, rank well and look stunning on every screen.
features: Any engine or CMS — WordPress, Tilda, headless and more

mobile.title: Mobile Applications
mobile.desc: One codebase, every platform. We ship native-feeling iOS and Android apps with React Native and handle the full path to the stores.
features: iOS & Android from a single codebase

engines.title: Any engine, or the modern way
engines.desc: Need it on a specific platform or CMS? Done. Want the fastest, most maintainable modern stack? Even better. You choose the destination — we choose the best road there.

tech.title: Built on a modern, battle-tested stack
tech.subtitle: We pick the right tool for the job — and keep everything fast, secure and easy to grow.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.desc: Interfaces that feel instant and delightful.

backend.title: Backend
backend.desc: Robust APIs and services that scale.

databases.title: Databases
databases.desc: Every modern database — relational or NoSQL.

about.title: Born in Sibiu, the heart of Transylvania
about.lead: Nexora is an independent IT studio rooted in Sibiu, Transylvania. We combine European craftsmanship with a modern engineering mindset.
about.body: We believe great software is equal parts beautiful and reliable. Every project gets thoughtful design, clean code and honest communication — from the first message to the final launch and beyond.

quality.title: Precision & quality
quality.desc: Delivered exactly to spec, tested and polished to the last detail.

speed.title: Fast turnaround
speed.desc: Clear timelines and rapid delivery, without cutting corners.

care.title: Real communication
care.desc: Responsive feedback and a partner who truly understands your goals.

modern.title: Future-proof tech
modern.desc: Modern stack that stays fast and easy to maintain as you grow.
